## AX.25 Packet Node GB7CAM

GB7CAM is a 2m AX.25 packet radio node serving the Cambridge area.  The station provides node, mailbox and chat services using LINBPQ and is connected to the wider packet radio network via RF and IP links.

<div id="api-status-widget" class="status-card metric-grid">

```{=html}
<script>
/* ----------------------------
   CONSTANTS & HELPERS
---------------------------- */
const RF_PORT = 1;
const AXIP_PORT = 3;
const FOUR_HOURS_MS = 4 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

function parseTime(st) {
  if (!st?.lastHeard) return NaN;

  const [datePart, timePart] = st.lastHeard.split(" ");
  if (!datePart || !timePart) return NaN;

  const [y, m, d] = datePart.split("-").map(Number);
  const [hh, mm, ss = 0] = timePart.split(":").map(Number);

  // Evaluate directly as a UTC timestamp to match your status page engine
  return Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d, hh, mm, ss);
}

/* ----------------------------
   FETCH DATA
---------------------------- */
async function fetchWidgetTelemetry() {
  const sEl = document.getElementById("w-status");
  const lEl = document.getElementById("w-links");
  const rEl = document.getElementById("w-rf");
  const aEl = document.getElementById("w-axip");
  const tEl = document.getElementById("w-last");
  const box = document.getElementById("api-status-widget");

  const base = "https://gb7cam.org.uk";

  function setOffline() {
    box.classList.remove("status-card--good", "status-card--bad");
    box.classList.add("status-card--bad");
    sEl.innerText = "Offline";
    lEl.innerText = "—";
    rEl.innerText = "—";
    aEl.innerText = "—";
    tEl.innerText = "Offline";
  }

  try {
    const [linksRes, mheardRes] = await Promise.all([
      fetch(`${base}/links`),
      fetch(`${base}/mheard/all`)
    ]);

    if (!linksRes.ok || !mheardRes.ok) {
      setOffline();
      return;
    }

    const linksData = await linksRes.json();
    const mheardData = await mheardRes.json();

    const links = linksData.links || [];
    const rawMheard = mheardData.mheard || [];

    lEl.innerText = links.length;

    let rfCount = 0;
    let axipCount = 0;
    let latestTimestamp = 0;
    let latestCallsign = "None";
    const cutoff = Date.now() - FOUR_HOURS_MS;

    rawMheard.forEach(station => {
      const ts = parseTime(station);

      if (!isNaN(ts)) {
        if (ts > latestTimestamp) {
          latestTimestamp = ts;
          latestCallsign = station.callSign || "Unknown";
        }

        if (ts >= cutoff) {
          const port = Number(station.port);
          if (port === RF_PORT) rfCount++;
          if (port === AXIP_PORT) axipCount++;
        }
      }
    });

    rEl.innerText = rfCount;
    aEl.innerText = axipCount;

    if (latestTimestamp > 0) {
      const diffMs = Date.now() - latestTimestamp;
      const diffMins = Math.max(0, Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60)));
      
      if (diffMins < 1) {
        tEl.innerText = `${latestCallsign} - Just now`;
      } else if (diffMins < 60) {
        tEl.innerText = `${latestCallsign} - ${diffMins} mins ago`;
      } else {
        const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMins / 60);
        tEl.innerText = `${latestCallsign} - ${diffHours} hour${diffHours > 1 ? 's' : ''} ago`;
      }
    } else {
      tEl.innerText = "No recent data";
    }

    const ok = links.length > 0;
    box.classList.remove("status-card--good", "status-card--bad");
    
    if (ok) {
      box.classList.add("status-card--good");
      sEl.innerText = "Operational";
    } else {
      box.classList.add("status-card--bad");
      sEl.innerText = "Degraded";
    }

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Widget engine failure:", error);
    setOffline();
  }
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  fetchWidgetTelemetry();
  setInterval(fetchWidgetTelemetry, 60000);
});
</script>
